shared_elements: human figures shown in profile/schematic frontal-profile
rows of repeated figures arranged in horizontal registers
processional line of many small figures
boat/vehicle-like elongated forms with repeated vertical strokes above (in A) vs. rows of upright figures (in B)
justification: Both surfaces are covered with repeated small human figures set out in roughly horizontal rows or registers, and both include animals, which gives a loose arrangement correspondence. But A's content is dominated by long boats with crew-strokes, footprint and cup-mark signs and stick-like schematic bodies, while B shows carefully modelled, individualised standing men in robes with headgear leading animals in a procession, separated by ornamental bands — different subjects rendered by wholly different conventions.
